verses.gurmukhi: ਅਧਿਆਤਮ ਕਰਮ ਪਰਮਾਤਮ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਤਤ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਤਹਿ ਪਰਮ ਤਤ ਵਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: adhiaatam karam paramaatam param padh tat mil tateh param tat vaasee hai ||

en.bdb: A rare Guru-conscious person attains the knowledge of spirituality through spiritual deeds and absorbs himself in Him as truth rejoins with Truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਟੇਕ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੇਕ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਧੁਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਭੈ ਅਭਿਆਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh bibek Tek ek hee anek mek ja(n)tr dhun raag naadh anabhai abhiaasee hai ||

en.bdb: As musical instruments produce melodious notes which also represent words in a song, so does a meditation practitioner merges in the fearless Lord who pervades in all and sundry.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਨਮਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਅਬਿਗਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਅਲਖ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharas dhiaan unamaan praan praanapat abigat gat at alakh bilaasee hai ||

en.bdb: As meditation renders all our breaths one with Lord- the granter of life, so would a Guru-conscious man be engrossed in Him by contemplating on Him and becomes capable of enjoying all His bliss by this union with Him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਟਾਛ ਦਿਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਭਏ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕੋਊ ਬਿਰਲੋ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਹੈ ॥੧੧੬॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)mirat kaTaachh dhib dheh kai bidheh bhe jeevan mukat kouoo biralo udhaasee hai ||116||

en.bdb: By the elixir-like divine glance of the True Guru, he becomes unconscious of his body (needs). Such a person with renounced and detached inclination is rare to come by. (116)
